content: Water that is pure to an extreme harbors no fish; a mind that is excessively demanding harbors no friends.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Shui zhi qing ze wu yu (水至清则无鱼) — Book of Han (Ban Gu)
explanation: Distilled, hyper-sterile water cannot support aquatic life; ecosystem vitality requires organic minerals and tolerance for imperfection. When you hold your friends, colleagues, and family to ruthless, impossible standards of perfection, you create an uninhabitable climate where genuine intimacy suffocates.
practicalInsight: Release the urge to critique someone's minor flaw or clumsy phrasing today. Leave room for human imperfection.
reflectionPrompt: Are your hyper-critical standards protecting your standards of excellence, or merely alienating the people who love you?
